why: Each part of the Mac workflow, as it works on the phone:

Needs you and review mode: one card at a time; swipe for next and previous, tap an option, my pick takes one tap only when I'm sure, and a note can be typed or dictated. The overview as a glance: the phase strip, since you last looked, health, and whose move it is per project. Send to agent with the queue. Notifications only when an agent is blocked, with my pick and a reply field. A Live Activity while an agent works. The Record is searchable. Media (screenshots, films with timecoded notes) open full screen.
Left on the Mac: the split panes, the terminals, anything that edits code.
